map.由应纳税额与税收抵免额求实缴税额: Compute net tax from tax due and tax credit
map.输入应纳税额与可抵免金额，求抵免后实缴。: Enter tax due and creditable amount to get the post-credit payable.
map.📖 查看「由应纳税额与税收抵免额求实缴税额 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Compute net tax from tax due and tax credit"
map.抵免直接减税额（非减所得）。: Credit cuts the tax directly (not the income).
map.用可抵免额度 c 减应纳税额 t，算抵免后税额。: Subtract creditable amount c from tax due t to get post-credit tax.
map.投资抵免、研发加计扣除等情形。: Cases like investment credit, R&D super deduction.
map.确认抵免不导致负税（取 max(0,…)）。: Ensure credit does not produce negative tax (take max(0, …)).
map.抵免后税额 = max(5000 − 1000, 0) = 4,000 元；若抵: Post-credit tax = max(5000 - 1000, 0) = 4,000; if credit 6000, take 0 (no refund).
map.部分制度下超额抵免可结转以后年度，本工具按当年实抵（不出现负税）处理。: Under some systems excess credit carries forward; this tool applies same-year credit (no negative tax).
map.抵免与扣除有何不同？: How does credit differ from deduction?
map.扣除减少计税依据，抵免直接减税额，后者减税效果更直接。: Deduction lowers the tax base; credit cuts tax directly, with a more immediate effect.
map.本工具取 max(0, 税−抵免)，不形成退税；是否结转以税法为准。: This tool takes max(0, tax - credit), no refund; carryforward follows tax law.
